# NextReach Studio

> NextReach Studio is an elite, senior-engineered software development and AI engineering studio based in Pune, India. We engineer bespoke websites, enterprise web applications, autonomous AI agent pipelines, and rapid MVPs under fixed-scope, guaranteed-turnaround contracts with direct principal engineer access.

NextReach Studio delivers high-performance digital systems for startups, local enterprises, and global businesses. We operate on 100% fixed-scope, one-time investment pricing with zero hourly billing surprises and guaranteed turnaround times (24-72 hours for website sprints, 2-4 weeks for custom software). Full source code and intellectual property ownership are transferred upon project completion.

> Identity: NextReach Studio is an independent studio based in Pune, India, operating exclusively at nextreachstudio.in. It is not affiliated with any other company using the name "NextReach".

## Solutions & Packages

- [⚡ Quick Launch Website Package](https://www.nextreachstudio.in/fast-websites): ₹5,000 (~$60 USD). 1-page mobile-first architecture, WhatsApp concierge, contact lead capture section, Vercel Edge CDN deployment. 1-2 day delivery.
- [💼 Business Website Package](https://www.nextreachstudio.in/fast-websites): ₹7,500 (~$90 USD). 3-5 sections/pages, service gallery, lead forms with instant WhatsApp alerts, local SEO schema. 2-3 day delivery.
- [✨ Premium Flagship Website Package](https://www.nextreachstudio.in/fast-websites): ₹10,000 (~$120 USD). 5-7 bespoke pages, luxury editorial UI/UX, fluid motion animations, Google Analytics 4, booking engine. 3-day delivery.
- [Custom Web Platforms & Multi-Tenant SaaS](https://www.nextreachstudio.in/services/custom-saas-development-pune): Full-stack database-driven platforms, admin portals, Stripe/Razorpay billing ($2,000-$5,000+).
- [Autonomous AI Agents & Workflows](https://www.nextreachstudio.in/services/ai-agent-development-pune): Custom multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, LLM document processors ($2,500-$6,000+).
- [Rapid MVP Engineering](https://www.nextreachstudio.in/services/mvp-development-pune): Real-user functional prototypes with database, authentication, and payments in 2-4 weeks ($2,000-$4,500+).
